title: Examples of photo storytelling

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Treat routine imagery as part of identity because people build their impression from repeated everyday encounters as well as campaigns.
strategic_value: Consistent Helsinki photo choices can connect news and social channels with larger brand communications.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section states the brand role of everyday imagery and shows four captures of city news, a web feature and a social-media campaign.
practical_value: Apply the same brand judgment to a news or social image that would be applied to advertising.

content_islands.name: Everyday-brand premise
content_islands.spec: Place the explanation above the examples.

content_islands.name: Channel examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange two news-page captures above a web-feature capture and a Facebook campaign post, preserving each image with its surrounding content.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explicitly equates the brand-building role of news/social images with campaign/advertising images.
reference_purposes.Expression: Four examples show city photography within its published news, web and social compositions.
reference_purposes.Application: The specimens demonstrate photography in ordinary news and social communications.
